Name: Add New NPC Jiu
Author: Jiusui9999
Description:
你好，我是模组的创作人[b]九岁[/b]（这不是我的年龄，是网名），我第一次做模组。若有问题和反馈请随时找我。
Hello, I'm the creator of the mod, my name's "[b]Jiusui[/b]" and I'm making my first mod. Please feel free to reach out to me if you have questions and feedback. (My English isn't very good. I'll use a translator.)

[b]！！！重要的事情！！！[/b]
本模组含有[b]抑郁[/b]元素，接受不了的请自行决定是否下载。
[b]!!! Important things!!![/b]
This module contains elements of [b]depression[/b], so if you can't accept it, please decide whether to download it or not.

本模组添加的东西有：
*增加了新的npc [b]桕[/b]（JIU）（适配1.6版本）
  •此NPC几乎与其他可结婚npc一样，会参加节日，拥有沙漠节专属商店。
  •此NPC有一件特别订单任务。
  •此NPC会在特定的日期发布一些邮件任务。
  •此NPC对某些特定物品有特殊对话（结婚后和结婚前也有不同的反应）。
  •一共有20多个事件（包含分叉事件）。
*更改了煤矿森林地图，在上面增加了桕的木屋
*增加了三个食物：炸螃蟹，五倍浓缩咖啡，拉面
*增加了五个家具（但你游玩中实际获得的只有两个）
The things added to this mod are:
*Added new npc Jiu(adapted to version 1.6)
  -This NPC attends festivals almost like any other marriageable npc and has an exclusive store for the Desert Festival.
  -This NPC has one special order quest.
  -This NPC will post some mail quests on specific dates.
  -This NPC has special dialog for certain specific items (also reacts differently after and before marriage).
  -There are more than 20 events in total (including forked events).
*Changed the Forest map by adding Jiu's Cabin on it
*Added three food items: fried crab, quintuple espresso, ramen
*Added five pieces of furniture (but you only actually get two in the tour)

精灵有参考了seasonal cute character 模组，所以你可以随时关闭桕精灵的鼻子（选项默认是开的）。
The sprites have references to the SEASONAL CUTE CHARACTER mod, so you can turn off the nose of Jiu sprite at any time (the option is on by default).

[s]我为自己打的广告，嘿！有没有人愿意跟我一起做模组啊啊啊啊！！！！！我实际上有很多主意来着。
I advertise myself, hey! Anyone want to do the module with me ahhhhhhhh ！！！！！ I actually have a lot of ideas.[/s]

[b]05/05/2024最新的计划！
[/b]此模组将和一个扩展模组进行合并以解决撞地图位置的问题！之后会做一些调整以及修改并且尝试与SVE进行适配。（内容会砍/加多少我不确定，但旧版本任然支持和提供各位下载）
05/05/2024 Latest plan!
This module will be merged with an expansion module to fix the bump map location issue! After that there will be some tweaks as well as modifications and attempts to adapt with SVE. (I'm not sure how much content will be cut/added, but the old version is still supported and available for download)

[b]更新日志 Update Log
[/b]12/5/2024
-改动了拉面的食谱
-修改了冬日星宴会的送礼代码
-新增几个事件以及修复特殊订单问题
-修复了多人联机的沙漠节限购问题
-修复了结婚后有几天的对话并没有翻译的问题
-重新适配了sve
-Changed the ramen recipe
-Changed the gift code for the Winter Star Banquet.
-Added several new events and fixed special order issues
-Fixed a problem with the Desert Festival purchase limit in multiplayer online.
-Fixed the problem that dialogs were not translated for a few days after marriage.
-Re-adapted sve

16/5/2024
很小的问题修复，并不影响游戏过程。
Very minor issue fixes that don't affect the gameplay.
-修复了8心事件没读取到i18n的问题
-修复了邀请看电影特殊对话没有读取到的问题
-Fixed the problem that the 8 hearts event didn't read the i18n.
-Fixed the issue that the Invitation to Movie special dialog was not read.

关于i18n我将新加的台词都放在了New下面，以及改动后的台词放在了Get change后面（所以您不必担心需要一个一个翻找它）
For i18n I've put the new lines under New and the changed lines after Get change (so you don't have to worry about having to go through them one by one).
